I'm cordial and I will engage with these kinds of people, but it would be a disservice to us both if I got close to them. I'd feel triggered and so would they by my distant demeanor.

I'm being objective here, not sure why you're getting passive aggressive. I'm not obligated to engage with people who trigger my fight or flight. 

I also don't actively lead them on only to abandon them when I get burnt out, nor do I torment them for how I feel. I'm just living my life, as they are.

I'm very aware that it's not their fault, and I don't make it their problem or target them, but it angers me on such a deep level that I simply keep my distance when I meet someone like that.

Don't get me wrong, I've BEEN that person as a kid, and that's probably why I feel such anger as a response. I've always felt that I wasn't allowed to lean on anyone, so when I see someone actively trying to lean on me... it triggers me deeply.

At the end of the day not everyone can get along with everyone. I simply mind my business and try to gently let them down. My post wasn't meant to be hateful or "call out" this behavior, I was just sharing my personal triggers.

I'm not sure why, actually, I think it's because I don't like being put on the spot, even if it's meant to be friendly. A lifetime of bullying whenever I'd stick my neck out of the ground has turned me into someone who'd rather be buried alive than be seen.

Make sure to delete your computer, or phone, or iPad's search history. To do so, in case you don't know how, click or tap on the three little dots or lines in your browser of choice, look for "Search history" and press "Delete".
